objects.original: Full real O(n) with normalized Haar probability; determinant-conditioned Haar laws; Eq4 precision A_O; centered Gaussian with covariance A_O inverse; their actual single-block mixtures P_+1 and P_-1; normalized event TV.
objects.reconstructed: The blind decoder gives the identical full group, canonical Haar constructor, literal twice-restricted sign measures, Eq4 matrix, inverse-precision multivariateGaussian, bind mixtures, and real event-gap supremum.
objects.evidence: Raw S2.p2 gives both sign components mass 1/2, so conditioning is exactly 2 times restriction. Raw S3.SS1 Eq4 and pre-Eq6 define these actual laws. orthogonalHaar is haarMeasure normalized on top; singleBlockPrecision is literally Eq4. GaussianLawDensity derives PosDef from singleBlockPrecision_regular and identifies the actual covariance-square-root Gaussian with the precision density. No substitute or assumed mixture is used.

domains.original: Natural block dimension n at least 3, real condition parameter kappa at least 4, O in full O(n), and x in real n-dimensional Euclidean space.
domains.reconstructed: n : Nat, hn : 3 <= n; kappa : Real, hkappa : 4 <= kappa; Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) Real; EuclideanSpace Real (Fin n).
domains.evidence: Raw Proposition B.7 explicitly says n >= 3 and kappa >= 4; Section3.1 supplies the dimension convention. Both endpoints and every parity occur in the candidate. Ambient d, k, and n=2T+1 are construction/application context, not B.7 premises. No n=2 extension is audited.

quantifiers.original: For every n >= 3 and kappa >= 4, the specified two mixtures obey both bounds; the TV supremum ranges over all measurable events.
quantifiers.reconstructed: Universal n and kappa with their range proofs; all measures and s are let-definitions; the event set is existential inside a real supremum over every measurable B.
quantifiers.evidence: The complete 120-line module contains a single theorem and no ambient variable/section binder. Exactly n, hn, kappa, hkappa are inputs; there is no caller-chosen law, radial parameter, event, witness, estimate, parity, or hidden typeclass premise. The event existential encodes the set of all measurable event gaps rather than choosing one event.

assumptions.original: Only the B.7 source ranges together with the defined source objects. Probability, measurable kernels, finiteness, integrability and selected scalar signs are proof obligations.
assumptions.reconstructed: Only hn : 3 <= n and hkappa : 4 <= kappa are mathematical hypotheses; source objects and event TV are defined internally.
assumptions.evidence: actual_mixture_laws proves measurable gamma, probability of both literal binds, and bind event formulas from component_probabilities and gaussian_law_eq_density. ActualTotalVariation installs those probability instances, proves the gap set nonempty and bounded by 1, and supplies the bounded-test estimate. selected_tilt proves r and ell signs. All are body calls, not public assumptions. Real event masses are finite because the actual mixtures are probabilities.

conclusion.reconstructed: The conjunction (1/2) exp(-5n/s) <= q^n/D and q^n/D <= delta for the actual event-supremum delta.
conclusion.evidence: Reversal of written inequality order and conjunction order is logical equivalence. The normalized supremum agrees with raw S2 accuracy convention after proving finite probability masses. Constants 1/2 and 5 and the full explicit ratio are unchanged. The theorem asserts neither supremum attainment nor amplification.

scopes.original: Single-block TV separation with real half-powers in Eq24 and Ex62; determinant parity disappears under absolute value; n and kappa determine all selected parameters.
scopes.reconstructed: Natural n-th powers for q and (-1); real rpow exponent (n:Real)/2 for a; literal total matrix inverse and real divisions, used only where positivity/nonzero is derived internally.
scopes.evidence: Eq24 last line is v=((-1)^n/n) q^n a^(n/2)/(1-r^2). he.2.2.2 rewrites precisely the density integral used by Eq20. hvabs removes (-1)^n without an even assumption; hhalf uses Mathlib real Bernoulli. hn0, hsp, ha, hprod, hD avoid all off-domain totalization issues. The A1 raw dimensional wording remains ambiguous but is not needed as a new premise or a certification beyond the B7 n>=3 use.

constant_dependencies.original: Fixed numerical constants 1/2 and 5; s, q, a, r, ell and D depend only on n and kappa; no oracle, block count, dimension d, seed or accuracy parameter.
constant_dependencies.reconstructed: Exactly the same fixed constants and dependencies; the two conclusions are fully specified functions of n and kappa and the source measures.
constant_dependencies.evidence: Ex62 gives the factor 1/2. Ex63 gives n(1-r^2)<=D with positive denominators, yielding q^n/D<=q^n/[n(1-r^2)]. NumericSeparation directly supplies the constant-five comparison. Its tangent-log route differs from raw p6.4 integral estimate, as candidate reader text explicitly records; it is a sufficient alternate proof with identical target/constants, not an added hypothesis.

deltas.description: Conditioning on half-mass determinant components is expanded to literal twice-restricted Haar measures and actual Gaussian binds; source semantics are preserved.
Measure.real and real sSup are made meaningful by internally proved probability, finiteness and bounded nonempty event-gap set, with no extra caller condition.
Real n/2 and totalized constructors are exposed; positivity and invertibility on the exact source range remove any semantic drift.

proof_route_note: NumericSeparation uses a tangent-log alternative sufficient proof. It is not certified identical to the author integral estimate. No n=2 extension is reviewed.
